reason: A DSH Web GUI plugin that adds a resizable bottom panel with multi-tab interactive shell terminals, persistent sessions, PTY-backed command execution, and terminal emulation.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供可调整大小、支持多标签和会话持久化的底部交互式终端面板。
summaries.en: Adds a resizable bottom panel with multi-tab interactive shell terminals and persistent sessions to the DSH Web GUI.

capabilities: Creates and manages interactive shell sessions through a PTY
Executes user-specified shell commands on the host system
Provides bidirectional terminal communication over WebSocket
Persists terminal session metadata and scrollback under the DSH home directory
